_comment: Curated IUCN Red List categories, keyed on the species_label segment of matched_taxon (id|Phylum|Class|species_label). Hand-picked for species that actually have a real, confident IUCN assessment in this author's knowledge -- most entries in the real reference FASTAs are accession-derived placeholders (18S) or unassessed obscure invertebrates/parasites (COI) and are deliberately left out of this table so they correctly default to 'unknown' rather than guessing. Never treat this as a live IUCN feed -- see the UI footnote.
